requiredQuestions.q: What formula/model/profile are you and what version/family owns you?
Are you candidate, qualified candidate, canonical-compared, canonical, adapted, held, rejected or superseded?
What epistemic claim class are you?
For what input domain/preconditions are you defined?
Are dimensions/units consistent and what normalization is required?
What assumptions make this model valid?
What singularities, counterexamples and known failures exist?
Are constants/thresholds mathematical constants, standard requirements, empirical estimates, heuristics or project targets?
What observation/test would falsify or limit this claim?
May this govern execution, constrain simulation, score evidence, or only suggest a profile?
If canonical authority is claimed, what artifact/version/hash/implementation and golden-vector evidence prove the binding?

law: UNKNOWN/BLOCKED must remain visible; self-inspection may not infer missing epistemic metadata.
